subject: [ALP-25] last quarter dock launch retro
snippet: Attaching the ALP-25 dock launch retrospective from last quarter. Key takeaways for the team: 1. Carton count discrepancies between warehouse and carrier manifests caused a 2-da
body:
Attaching the ALP-25 dock launch retrospective from last quarter. Key takeaways for the team:

1. Carton count discrepancies between warehouse and carrier manifests caused a 2-day delay at the port. We've since implemented dual sign-off on packing lists.
2. FCC paperwork arrived 72 hours late because the lab sent the attestation to our old entity name. Updated the vendor contact sheet.
3. VIP pre-order communication went out before support had the canned responses ready — resulted in 14 escalations. Next round we stage the responses 48 hours ahead.
4. PDP hero image was swapped to the wrong colorway by creative; caught during QA but only 6 hours before listing went live.

Filed under Retro > Product Launches if anyone needs it for reference.

body:
WEEKLY DOCK ACCESSORY SUPPLIER DIGEST — June 19, 2025

Top stories this week:

FCC Part 15 Label Updates: The FCC published revised guidance on label placement for wireless charging accessories effective Q4 2025. Manufacturers should review updated templates on the FCC Equipment Authorization site.

Logistics Watch: West Coast port congestion eased this week with average container dwell times dropping to 3.2 days. Shenzhen-to-LA transit remains at 14-16 days for standard ocean freight.

Materials Spotlight: Recycled molded fiber inserts continue gaining traction as brands move away from EPS foam. Cost premium narrowing to ~8% over conventional packaging.

Trade Show: Hong Kong Electronics Fair early-bird registration closes July 1. Use code DOCKWEEKLY for 20% off exhibitor passes.

To unsubscribe, reply STOP.
